scripts.build: npm -w hosting run build && npm -w functions run build
scripts.lint: npm -w hosting run lint && npm -w functions run lint && npm run lint:rules
scripts.lint:rules: vp lint -c functions/oxlint-rules.json --tsconfig functions/tsconfig.json firestore/firestore.rules.test.ts storage/storage.rules.test.ts
scripts.fmt: npm -w hosting run fmt && npm -w functions run fmt && vp fmt -c .oxfmtrc.json firestore storage
scripts.test: npm -w hosting run test && npm -w functions run test
scripts.emulators: npm run emulators:kill && mkdir -p .artifacts/firebase && cd .artifacts/firebase && firebase --config ../../firebase.json emulators:start --project "${FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID:-tokiwa-template}"
